## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin-dco))
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and lint, tests and build pass locally
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed (README / manual / architecture; ADR for design decisions)
- [ ] New UI strings exist in both `en.json` and `de.json`
- [ ] New API routes and fields have self-explanatory descriptions in `/docs`
- [ ] No real hostnames, tokens or customer data in code, tests or screenshots
